user.description: Connect to a running pipewire_audio_router add-on instance.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge daemon at that host/port.

abort.already_configured: This bridge daemon is already configured.

state.area: Only the room being talked to
state.music_group: The whole music group of that room

link.name: Link source
link.description: Connect an audio source to this output. Additive: any source already linked to the output stays connected.

source.name: Source
source.description: Name of the source to connect, as shown in the output's source list.

unlink.name: Unlink source
unlink.description: Disconnect an audio source from this output. If no source is given, every source currently feeding the output is disconnected.

source.name: Source
source.description: Name of the source to disconnect. Leave empty to disconnect all sources from the output.

activate_preset.name: Activate music group preset
activate_preset.description: Put a music-group preset in force: the speakers are regrouped and each group is put back on the source that preset plays.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Name of the preset to activate, as shown on the add-on's Music groups page.

entry_id.name: Router
entry_id.description: Config entry id of the router to switch. Only needed when more than one PipeWire Audio Router is configured.
